verdict.rationale: Agent Studio lets teams define step-by-step workflows (journeys) or generate them from existing operating procedures, and Ghostwriter accepts uploaded SOPs to build journeys. The Agent SDK supports writing journeys as code with "sophisticated logic", and Insights mentions tuning "levels of determinism", which points toward controllable branching. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deterministic branching semantics (conditional paths, guaranteed step ordering), per-issue-type routing into specific SOPs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents follow encoded SOPs step-by-step.
